FinancialInstitution.name: Financial Institution
FinancialInstitution.definition: Financial institution-related data required by business and/or regulation (for example, money or funds transfer).

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the customer assigned by a party.

Designation.name: Designation
Designation.definition: Identifies the specific customer when multiple customers are associated with the same account.

Contact.name: Contact
Contact.definition: Detail contact information of the customer.

CountryOfBirth.name: Country Of Birth
CountryOfBirth.definition: Country of Birth information (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3)

DateOfBirth.name: Date Of Birth
DateOfBirth.definition: Date of birth of the party.

AdditionalData.name: Additional Data
AdditionalData.definition: Additional information related to the customer.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains text fields in the local language.
